market.title: Starship: Humans to Mars Before 2030
resolutionNote: Kalshi's own wording: "If SpaceX launches a manned Starship mission to Mars by Dec 31, 2029, then the market resolves to Yes."

This is the crewed-mission-specific contract -- don't confuse it with Kalshi's separate "Will SpaceX land anything successfully on Mars before 2030?" market, which also counts uncrewed landings and has traded notably higher (around 27-31%, vs. roughly 17% here).
No confirmed Polymarket market with matching crewed-by-2030 resolution criteria was found, so this page is Kalshi-only.

marketBrief.text: Musk's public framing hasn't changed -- SpaceX exists to make humanity multi-planetary -- but its paperwork is more cautious. Mars came up 63 times in SpaceX's Nasdaq IPO prospectus, yet the filing declined to commit to a timeline, warning unproven initiatives 'may be difficult or impossible to determine.' That gap shows up in the price: Kalshi has this crewed-mission contract at 17%, below the separate 'will SpaceX land anything on Mars' market (uncrewed included), near 27-31%. Starship's 13th test flight on July 24, its first since the IPO, showed real progress -- an intact heat shield, a soft splashdown -- but also how far reusability still has to go.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
